injuries.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.
Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
Prince (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.
Holland is out for Tuesday's game against San Antonio due to a left knee contusion.
Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
